html:
Remark. Legacy empirical \alpha_{EM} forms (deprecated — superseded by the pre-archimedean trace-ratio)

Remark (deprecated empirical \alpha_{EM} forms). The categorical fine-structure constant relies exclusively on the pre-archimedean evaluation:

  \alpha_{EM} \;=\; \frac{h^2}{q\,\delta_q(T_{2,9})\,\delta_q(T_{3,5})}
              \;=\; \frac{1}{q\,[9]_q\,[10]_q}.

Older isolated PSLQ-uniqueness guesses matching q_0 lack theoretical backing. These residual artifacts fail exact representation limits and smooth q continuity. They exist only as historical diagnostic markers and are replaced by the exact Hopf 2-strand operation model.
